title: Listening Drill — Student newspaper meeting — Guided practice
description: Practical demonstration. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Student newspaper meeting — Guided practice
sections.transcript:
TUTOR: Before our demonstration on student newspaper meeting, let me explain what you need and what to record. Collect your materials from the edit suite before the demonstration begins. Inside the handout you will find a blank page proof to fill in.

TUTOR: Watch the demonstration once before you try it. Before you begin, check for the fault that affected the previous group: missing headline. If you notice it, let me know instead of making an adjustment yourself.

TUTOR: Now work in pairs. After the first attempt, check picture credits and write the result down immediately. You then have twenty minutes to compare your result with your partner’s. You can disagree, but both partners should keep a note of what they observed.

TUTOR: On your way out, take anything you borrowed back to the press office. Please leave your notes in the folder so we can discuss them next time.
